jobs.title: Senior Mobile Developer
jobs.description:
**About Numan** 

Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.

Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.

To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: 

• Patients first.

• Learn fast.

• Own the quality.

• Succeed together.

• Care deeply.

Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

**The Role:** 

We're hiring a Senior Mobile Developer to help build and scale the Numan app on iOS and Android.

For many patients, the app is Numan. It's where they complete their consultation, manage their treatment and subscriptions, book and track tests, message their clinician and health coach, and follow their programme day to day. When it's fast, clear and reliable, patients stay on track with their health. When it isn't, they drop off.

You'll work in a cross-functional squad with product, design and backend engineers. You'll own features from idea to App Store and Google Play, shape the app's architecture, and raise the bar on quality across the mobile team. This is a Level 5 (Senior Engineer) role in our engineering framework: you'll deliver large features across a whole product area, think holistically about the app, and collaborate with and mentor the engineers around you.

You'll be working with special category health data, so privacy, security and accessibility are part of the job, not an afterthought.

# You will:

* Design, build and ship features in the Numan app, owning them from technical scoping through release and post-launch monitoring.

* Write production-quality native code in Swift and SwiftUI (iOS) or Kotlin and Jetpack Compose (Android), with strong test coverage.

* Shape and evolve the app's architecture: modularisation, state management, networking, offline behaviour and how we share patterns across platforms.

* Work with product and design to turn patient problems into simple, accessible experiences, and push back when a simpler approach would serve patients better.

* Partner with backend engineers on API design so the app gets the data it needs, efficiently and securely.

* Own app quality: crash rates, performance, startup time and accessibility (WCAG). Use monitoring and analytics to find and fix problems before patients notice them.

* Improve our mobile delivery pipeline: CI/CD, automated testing, feature flags, phased rollouts and App Store / Google Play release management.

* Protect patient data. Build with secure storage, authentication and privacy in mind, in line with UK GDPR and healthcare requirements.

* Give thorough, constructive code reviews and write clear documentation, RFCs and PR descriptions.

* Mentor other engineers, share knowledge across the mobile team, and help set standards and working practices.

* Interview candidates and help us grow the team.

* Use AI coding assistants thoughtfully to move faster without lowering the bar on quality.

,

# You'll have:

* 5+ years building mobile apps professionally, with at least one consumer app you've helped ship and scale on the App Store or Google Play.

* Deep expertise in native development on at least one platform: Swift and SwiftUI (iOS) or Kotlin and Jetpack Compose (Android). Working knowledge of the other platform is a plus.

* A strong grasp of mobile architecture (for example MVVM, unidirectional data flow, dependency injection, modularisation) and the judgement to know when to keep things simple.

* A testing mindset: unit, UI and snapshot testing, and experience building testable code.

* Experience with CI/CD for mobile (for example Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions or Xcode Cloud) and managing releases end to end.

* Experience integrating with REST or GraphQL APIs, handling auth, caching and error states well.

* A track record of owning large features or product areas and improving the engineering practices of the team around you.

* Experience mentoring engineers and giving useful code reviews.

* Clear communication with engineers and non-engineers alike, and comfort working closely with product and design.

* Care for patients and an understanding of why privacy and accessibility matter in health products.

* Experience working in an agile team, delivering in sprints and working effectively with product and design to deliver real value to customers often.

**Our benefits include...**

📈  -  Share options.

🏖  -  25 days holiday, plus bank holidays (increasing to 30 the longer you stay with Numan). 

🩺  -  Health insurance with [Vitality](https://vitality.co.uk).🚘  - Electric car salary sacrifice scheme with [Octopus](https://octopus.energy).🧸  -  Enhanced maternity and parental leave.

🥳  -  A day off on your Birthday! 

🐥  -  Nursery benefit provided by [YellowNest](https://t.eu.lever-analytics.com/email-link?dest=https://www.yellownest.co.uk/&eid=6e6c0e9a-759a-40bb-9652-414e62aca13d&idx=1&token=Gvi_-dygDyEsLomYdt9DxV5Kh4g).💼  -  Employee assistance programme (access to therapy, financial planning and discounts).

⚖️  -  Generous pension (includes both employee and employer contributions).

💻  -  Flexible working options, including a dog-friendly office in Farringdon. 

📚  -  Personal training and development budget via Learnerbly. 

👟  -  Wellhub membership, giving you access to over 2,000 locations in the UK. 

🚲  -  Cycle to work scheme.

🚆  -  Season ticket loan. 

%   -  Discount on Numan products for your friends and family.

🤲  -  Paid volunteering days. 

📅  -  An additional 2 weeks off once you reach your 5th anniversary with Numan.

**Diversity at Numan**

At Numan, people are at the heart of who we are. We recognise and value the unique perspectives and experiences that individuals from all backgrounds bring.

We promote innovation and creativity, enabling us to tackle things from various viewpoints and are committed to equal opportunities and continuously strive to create a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and valued.

Embracing diversity isn't just our goal; it's our strength, driving us towards a more inclusive future.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Membership (Payments)
jobs.description:
We are Europe’s leading podcasting platform, home to award winning exclusive originals, audiobooks and podcasts. We work with some of the best and most exciting Creators across Europe, and publish over 700 episodes a month, all powered by our innovative technology and a seamless consumer experience. We are now looking for Senior Backend Engineer, Membership (Payments) to join our amazing team.

## **This is the role**

You'll join Membership, the cross-functional team that owns the subscriber lifecycle, and own the backend behind how listeners pay for Podimo. This code handles real money: when it breaks, people get charged twice or lose access to what they paid for.

How we build: engineers on the big features, agents on everything else. A crew of small, single-purpose agents is taking over the upkeep (dependency upgrades, flaky tests, alert triage, low-risk bugs), so your time goes to the hard problems: payment architecture, new markets and payment methods, and the features listeners notice. You decide what gets built and how, and you own what you ship.

**Your main responsibilities**

* Own payment plans, offers, subscriptions, gift cards, and promo codes across web payments (Adyen, Vipps/MobilePay) and in-app purchases (Apple, Google Play)

* Keep money flows correct and observable: idempotency, webhooks, store notifications

* Lead epics of cross-team features and technical initiatives

* Build the APIs our Android, iOS, and Web apps use for paywalls, checkout, and account management

* Build the guardrails agents work inside: architecture, tests, automated checks, and the context they run on

**Our stack:** Kotlin, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL,TypeScript, MySQL, Pub/Sub, GraphQL, and Kubernetes on Google Cloud, with AI coding agents every day.

**How you'll grow:** You'll shape how a payments team works with agents, from the guardrails to the workflows other teams reuse. The path continues to staff and lead roles, where engineers set standards, build agent workflows, and coach the team.

## **This is you**

* You've built and run backend services in production. We work in Kotlin and TypeScript, but your judgment matters more to us than any single language

* You read code and architecture quickly and can judge what's right and what will break, whether a person or an agent wrote it

* You know where distributed systems fail: retries, race conditions, idempotency, and partial failures

* You work with AI agents daily: you write clear specs, review their output critically, and know when to take the keyboard back

* You communicate like an owner, in clear English

**Big plus:** payments experience, such as payment providers, app store billing, subscriptions. Naturally, being passionate and knowledgeable about podcasts, audio and video content, creators, entertainment and the media industry is also a plus!

## **What We Offer**

* Up to six months of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, any gender

* Participation in our ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Program)

* A third-pillar pension plan: we contribute to your long-term savings

* AI tooling: no limits on licenses or usage

* Learning and development budget, including courses and conferences

* Flexible hours and a hybrid setup, plus free daily lunch at our Vilnius city-center office

* Gross salary: from 5,833 EUR/month for the Lithuanian market, depending on your skills and experience

## **This is us**

Podimo is Europe’s leading podcasting platform, home to award-winning exclusive originals, audiobooks, and podcasts with over 1.2 million subscribers and delivering over 700 curated episodes a month. Offering premium entertainment through a seamless experience, Podimo combines end-to-end production powered by innovative technology and a creator-first model that rewards creators for producing exceptional content that engages and entertains audiences.

Through Podimo Studios, we produce, monetise and distribute great stories and shows, either in-house or via our four labels: Podads in Denmark, [arc.studio](https://arc.studio) in Germany, and Dutch labels Tonny Media and Dag en Nacht Media. This helps us to deliver integrated, high-quality entertainment across multiple marketsWe’re fiercely passionate about discovering, creating, and obsessing over great stories and the experience our app offers. We help our creators connect directly with their fans, building communities and fandoms to bring their most exciting ideas and stories to life and increase their engagement.

We’re a courageous and curious bunch. We recognise the value every individual brings, and respect everyone’s contribution and time. We approach our work with integrity and humility, and believe that we are better together. We have zero time for sharp elbows and big egos. We love what we do, but more importantly, we have a good time doing it.

We are building a company and culture that mirrors the diversity of the world we’re living in. This means: diversity of talent, voices, ideas, and thoughts. That goes both for our brand, our content, our creators, and our teams.

You are welcome at Podimo for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what stories you have playing in your headphones.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Audience
jobs.description:
**Working at Omnisend is... kind of boring.**

Not the soul-crushing kind of boring — more like the “no drama, no chaos, just smart people doing great work” kind. The kind that lets you focus on what matters, without pointless meetings, micromanagement, or bureaucracy. We’re data-driven. We test, we iterate, we improve. Gut feelings don’t drive decisions — insights do. We trust each other. We’re transparent, give real feedback, and actually listen. No egos, no hand-holding — just a team of experienced professionals moving fast, adapting easily, and delivering impact. Omnisend is customer-funded and customer-driven. Our work is rooted in solving real problems that help ecommerce brands grow. No empty promises — we bring in results. And yes, we have fun. But the grown-up kind — workations, team gatherings, the occasional party. No forced fun, no awkward icebreakers. Just genuine moments with a team that actually enjoys working together.

**About the role:**

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a focus on backend development. Proactive, product-minded individuals who are enthusiastic about crafting impactful and scalable software products will thrive at Omnisend. You would join the Audience team that helps ecommerce businesses to make marketing messages personal by providing their customer insights and effective targeting capabilities.

**The Audience team is responsible for:**

**Contact profiles** - 1.4 billion contact profiles across all active stores: identity, properties and the full stream processing of shopping behavior from stores, forms and integrations. That’s up to 20,000+ events per second.**Segmentation engine** - turns ~10 billion behavioral events a month into always-fresh customer groups. It processes over a billion segment entries and exits every month, so the right customers get the right message at the right moment. Keeping that fast and accurate at our scale is the core engineering challenge of the team.**AI and pre-built segments** - merchants describe an audience in plain words and get a segment, or start from ready-made segments based on proven e-commerce practices. No marketing expertise needed.

# What you’ll do @Omnisend:

* Contribute significantly to product development decisions.

* Design, develop, and test features.

* Resolve technical challenges for seamless system functionality and optimal performance.

* Maintain features with effective monitoring, logging, and alerting.

* Share best practices with team members.

,

# We expect that you’ll bring:

* Hands-on experience (5+ years) implementing and maintaining scalable, highly available, high-load systems.

* Customer centricity - putting the customer at the core of all business decisions and actions.

* Ideally, experience with Golang or alternatively proficiency in any backend programming language with the willingness to learn Golang.

* Experience with React or any equivalent framework with willingness to learn React.

* Familiarity with modern software build pipelines and tools.

* Proficiency in NoSQL and SQL database, with willingness to learn MongoDB, Bigtable, PostgreSQL.

* Experience with real-time distributed messaging tools, like NSQ, Pub/Sub.

* Working experience with any cloud provider (at Omnisend we use Google Cloud Services).

* Experience with event-based architecture.

* AI-first engineering. Coding agents are part of how we build. You don’t need to arrive fluent - you do need to want to get there..

,

# How we work and what we value:

* Company-wide OKR.

* Empowered product teams that solve customer and business problems.

* Objective-based planning and experimentation-driven delivery.

* Product-led growth.

* We look at product metrics daily, we speak to our customers, and do it often.

* Outcomes and bringing value to our customers over outputs and feature factories.

* Ship to learn. Experimentation to validate hypotheses and assumptions.

* Truly embracing data-driven decisions.

,

# What we offer in return:

* Gross salary starting point from 6000 EUR/month based on experience.

* Quarterly salary reviews.

* An unlimited learning budget for self-improvement complying with the best interest of Omnisend.

* Working methods and best practices inspired by the best tech companies in Silicon Valley.

* Over 80% senior colleagues in Product - and over half company-wide - to accelerate your growth.

* Flexible working hours.

* Hybrid work (in Vilnius, Kaunas, Charleston): three days a week in the office with your team, two from home. Fully remote if you’re based elsewhere.

* Possibility to work from anywhere in the world.

* Private health insurance.

* Unlimited access to psychotherapy.

* Workstation budget.

* Personalized work anniversary gifts (house cleaning, spa treatments, international flights etc.).

* Annual company trip abroad, company gatherings twice a year, team-led teambuildings.

* Additional days off for KASP and Rifleman’s Union members.

* Inclusive family-related time-off policy.

Omnisend is an email and SMS marketing platform built for ecommerce brands. With one-click integration to major ecommerce platforms, intuitive automation, and powerful email templates, we make sophisticated marketing effortless — no learning curve required.

Award-winning 24/7/365 customer support? Check. A platform trusted by growing brands and seasoned pros alike? Absolutely. The idea that “great marketing needs to be expensive”? Our 150,000+ customers prove that wrong every day.

**Working at Omnisend is... kind of boring.**

Not the soul-crushing kind of boring — more like the “no drama, no chaos, just smart people doing great work” kind. The kind that lets you focus on what matters, without pointless meetings, micromanagement, or bureaucracy. We’re data-driven. We test, we iterate, we improve. Gut feelings don’t drive decisions — insights do. We trust each other. We’re transparent, give real feedback, and actually listen. No egos, no hand-holding — just a team of experienced professionals moving fast, adapting easily, and delivering impact. Omnisend is customer-funded and customer-driven. Our work is rooted in solving real problems that help ecommerce brands grow. No empty promises — we bring in results. And yes, we have fun. But the grown-up kind — workations, team gatherings, the occasional party. No forced fun, no awkward icebreakers. Just genuine moments with a team that actually enjoys working together.

**About the role:**

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a focus on backend development. Proactive, product-minded individuals who are enthusiastic about crafting impactful and scalable software products will thrive at Omnisend. You would join the Audience team that helps ecommerce businesses to make marketing messages personal by providing their customer insights and effective targeting capabilities.

**The Audience team is responsible for:**

**Contact profiles** - 1.4 billion contact profiles across all active stores: identity, properties and the full stream processing of shopping behavior from stores, forms and integrations. That’s up to 20,000+ events per second.**Segmentation engine** - turns ~10 billion behavioral events a month into always-fresh customer groups. It processes over a billion segment entries and exits every month, so the right customers get the right message at the right moment. Keeping that fast and accurate at our scale is the core engineering challenge of the team.**AI and pre-built segments** - merchants describe an audience in plain words and get a segment, or start from ready-made segments based on proven e-commerce practices. No marketing expertise needed.

# What you’ll do @Omnisend:

* Contribute significantly to product development decisions.

* Design, develop, and test features.

* Resolve technical challenges for seamless system functionality and optimal performance.

* Maintain features with effective monitoring, logging, and alerting.

* Share best practices with team members.

,

# We expect that you’ll bring:

* Hands-on experience (5+ years) implementing and maintaining scalable, highly available, high-load systems.

* Customer centricity - putting the customer at the core of all business decisions and actions.

* Ideally, experience with Golang or alternatively proficiency in any backend programming language with the willingness to learn Golang.

* Experience with React or any equivalent framework with willingness to learn React.

* Familiarity with modern software build pipelines and tools.

* Proficiency in NoSQL and SQL database, with willingness to learn MongoDB, Bigtable, PostgreSQL.

* Experience with real-time distributed messaging tools, like NSQ, Pub/Sub.

* Working experience with any cloud provider (at Omnisend we use Google Cloud Services).

* Experience with event-based architecture.

* AI-first engineering. Coding agents are part of how we build. You don’t need to arrive fluent - you do need to want to get there..

,

# How we work and what we value:

* Company-wide OKR.

* Empowered product teams that solve customer and business problems.

* Objective-based planning and experimentation-driven delivery.

* Product-led growth.

* We look at product metrics daily, we speak to our customers, and do it often.

* Outcomes and bringing value to our customers over outputs and feature factories.

* Ship to learn. Experimentation to validate hypotheses and assumptions.

* Truly embracing data-driven decisions.

,

# What we offer in return:

* Gross salary starting point from 6000 EUR/month based on experience.

* Quarterly salary reviews.

* An unlimited learning budget for self-improvement complying with the best interest of Omnisend.

* Working methods and best practices inspired by the best tech companies in Silicon Valley.

* Over 80% senior colleagues in Product - and over half company-wide - to accelerate your growth.

* Flexible working hours.

* Hybrid work (in Vilnius, Kaunas, Charleston): three days a week in the office with your team, two from home. Fully remote if you’re based elsewhere.

* Possibility to work from anywhere in the world.

* Private health insurance.

* Unlimited access to psychotherapy.

* Workstation budget.

* Personalized work anniversary gifts (house cleaning, spa treatments, international flights etc.).

* Annual company trip abroad, company gatherings twice a year, team-led teambuildings.

* Additional days off for KASP and Rifleman’s Union members.

* Inclusive family-related time-off policy.

Omnisend is an email and SMS marketing platform built for ecommerce brands. With one-click integration to major ecommerce platforms, intuitive automation, and powerful email templates, we make sophisticated marketing effortless — no learning curve required.

Award-winning 24/7/365 customer support? Check. A platform trusted by growing brands and seasoned pros alike? Absolutely. The idea that “great marketing needs to be expensive”? Our 150,000+ customers prove that wrong every day.

jobs.title: Senior Android Developer (Remote)
jobs.description:
**About Finom**

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

We recently closed a **€115 million Series C equity round** (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We're looking for a **Senior Android Engineer or Tech Lead** who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, not just the tickets in the backlog.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team (Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product) and own the end-to-end development of features that genuinely matter: company accounts and cash flows, banking transactions, card issuance and management, and AI-enabled accounting. You'll help shape architecture decisions, raise the bar on engineering quality, and mentor the engineers around you.

If you're energized by working at the intersection of great mobile engineering and real product impact — this is the role.

# What You’ll Do

* Design and build new features for our Android application, used daily by business owners across Europe.

* Architect and implement reliable, intuitive solutions for:

* Multi-account cash flow management

* Banking transactions and payments

* Physical and virtual card issuance, activation, and control

* AI-powered accounting automation

* Build polished, responsive UIs using **Jetpack Compose**.

* Take ownership of code quality, performance, and stability — automated testing and thorough code reviews are non-negotiable.

* Collaborate closely with Backend, QA, Design, and Product — you'll be shaping solutions end-to-end, not just implementing specs.

* Drive technical decisions within your domain, challenge assumptions when needed, and proactively identify opportunities to build better.

* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

,

# Who You Are

You're pragmatic and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and thrive in a cross-functional environment where everyone is solving the same customer problem together.

**Your experience includes:**

* Strong knowledge of **Kotlin** (Java knowledge is a plus) and 5+ years of commercial Android development.

* Deep understanding of **OOP**, **SOLID**, and **Clean Architecture**.

* Solid experience with presentation layer patterns — **MVI**, **MVVM**, and **MVP** — and the ability to choose the right one for the context.

* Hands-on experience with our core stack:

* Reactive programming & async: **RxJava**, **Kotlin Coroutines / Flow**

* Dependency injection: **Dagger 2**, **Hilt**, or **Koin**

* Networking: **Retrofit**

* Navigation: **Cicerone**, **Jetpack Navigation Component**

* Modern UI: **Jetpack Compose**

* Practical experience with **Firebase** (FCM, Analytics, Crashlytics).

* Experience with **Feature-module architecture** in production.

* Confidence with **Git / GitLab**, including setting up and maintaining **GitLab CI/CD**.

* A builder's mentality — you care about the product, the users, and the outcomes, not just the code.

* Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences.

,

# Nice to Have

* Background in fintech or experience with financial products — you understand the stakes.

* Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).

* Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing overdraw, improving recomposition efficiency in Jetpack Compose, and hitting smooth 60/120fps rendering.

* Hands-on work with performance tooling: **Android Profiler**, **Perfetto**, **Baseline Profiles**, or similar.

* Published apps on **Google Play** you're proud of.

* An active **GitHub** profile with code you're happy to share.

* Hands-on experience with **AI agents and LLM tools** (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) — setting up agent environments, writing prompts, skills, and behavioral rules.

* Experience with **AI-powered IDE tools** (Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) — including agent mode, rules files configuration, and integrating AI into the daily development workflow.

* Understanding of model **capabilities and limitations** — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.

* Ability to **evaluate and verify AI-generated output** — using automated tests, linters, and critical review to catch hallucinations and errors.

* Awareness of **AI security risks** — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

Recruitment Flow

* Talent Partner Interview

* First Technical Interview

* Mobile System Design Interview

* Team Fit Interview (peer interview)

* Offer

**What You Will Get In Return**

**Make a genuine impact on the product**

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.

**Work in the EU**

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

**Become a stock options holder**

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.

**Receive unwavering support and care**

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

**Work & Swim program**

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

**Equal Opportunity Statement** 

At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: iOS Developer
jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY**

At Boozt we pride ourselves on being a tech-driven company, with a flat nordic structure, collaborative and friendly atmosphere, and a rich and diverse company culture, spread across 5 offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Malmø, Vilnius and Poznan.

In the iOS team we currently have 3 apps, where you will be mostly working on the two consumer facing ones: Boozt or Booztlet.

We have a pure Swift codebase based on Clean Swift architecture, which is modularized and shared between our apps. As we are coders, we have UI-as-code, documentation-as-code and configuration-as-code. Our current challenges include: strengthening our testing and automation setup, modularizing and sharing more code between apps and implementing Clean Swift in the entire codebase.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Developing exciting features for one of our existing apps.

* Using the newest technology to create Innovation Projects that are relevant for Boozt.

* Participate in the development of new apps for the (almost fully robotified) Warehouse, Booztlet Stores, Brand Partner or End Customers.

* Participate in the iOS Chapter and form the future of how we should use iOS in our team.

**YOUR PROFILE**

* Minimum 3 years experience within iOS development,

* Experience with all the networking technologies used in today's mobile landscape, especially all the ins and outs of HTTP and REST.

* Good understanding of software development patterns and principles like SOLID

* Preferable if you have work experience in mastering data flow, decoupling and architecture in a large data driven app.

* Have the ability and are excited about working with a large modularised codebase

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!Only applications submitted in English will be considered.**

**Important:** Applicants must have the legal right to work in Lithuania at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under [Recruitment.](https://careers.booztgroup.com/pages/recruitment)[](https://careers.booztgroup.com/pages/recruitment)**Boozt perks**+5 vacation days.Health insurance and Office bikes.Scandinavian workplace culture. Focusing on work-life balance.International team. Multicultural colleagues, cross-functional teams, and daily English communication with a good sense of humor.Generous staff discount.

**Salary: 4500-5700 Eur gross**

**A LITTLE BIT ABOUT US**We are one of the leading e-commerce players in the Nordics. We offer our customers fashion, kids, sports, beauty, and home on [](https://boozt.com)[Boozt.com](https://boozt.com) and [](https://booztlet.com)[Booztlet.com](https://booztlet.com). Headquartered in Copenhagen, with over 1,100 colleagues across Europe, tech hubs in Vilnius and Poznań, and a fully automated warehouse in Ängelholm, we create value for both consumers and brands while fostering diversity, inclusion, and innovation.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Boozt is a tech company that happens to sell fashion. Flat Nordic structure, five offices (Copenhagen, Aarhus, Malmö, Vilnius and Poznań), and a culture where "nerdy" is a compliment. We experiment, we make data-driven decisions, and we run several annual hackathons, mostly because we would be doing that stuff anyway.

In the iOS team we build the two apps our customers actually shop with: Boozt and Booztlet.

Shoppers across the Nordics and beyond, one shared codebase, and a team small enough that your opinion moves things. We ship on a steady release train and we like to keep it rolling, so what you build does not sit in a branch for months. It goes out, and the data tells you how it landed.

We also like to live on the cutting edge in the iOS Chapter. New Swift version, new SDK, new tooling: we are on it early, on purpose, because staying current is cheaper than catching up.

The codebase shows it: Swift 6 adopted, pure Swift, 40+ Swift packages shared between the apps with a tight dependency graph, and UI as code (storyboards were never invited). CleanSwift in UIKit, MVVM where we do SwiftUI, and documentation and configuration as code, because clicking through settings is not version controlled.

What keeps us busy right now: growing our SwiftUI footprint, strengthening testing and automation, and pushing what AI coding agents can do for us.We use AI a lot, but you have to be the expert. The agents take care of plenty of the typing, while the judgement, the architecture and the final call stay with you. We think that combination makes the craft more fun, not less.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Ship features to shoppers across the Nordics and beyond, and keep the release train rolling.

* Work in one of the larger modularised Swift codebases around, and help us share even more code between the apps.

* Work with the newest Swift and iOS features early, not two years after the keynote.

* Work with coding agents as part of your daily flow. We build and maintain our own agentic setup in the iOS Chapter, and you will help shape it.

* Have a real voice in the iOS Chapter: how we build, what we adopt, what we retire.

* Enjoy Research Friday every other week: time set aside to research, play and learn whatever makes you a better developer.

**YOUR PROFILE**

* 3+ years of iOS development experience.

* Great Swift knowledge, and you know your way around HTTP and REST.

* You know a good data contract when you see it.

* You can talk about SOLID, decoupling and data flow.

* A large modularised codebase excites you rather than scares you.

* Curious about everything new. We like to experiment, and you will get plenty of chances to.

* Experience with modern Swift concurrency (async/await, actors) is a plus.

* Fluent in English, our corporate language (**only applications in English will be considered**).

The rest is simple: you are nerdy, curious and always up for learning more.

You are a team player who thinks work should be fun.

We give you trust and freedom, and you bring the responsibility that comes with them.

**Important:** Applicants must have the legal right to work in Lithuania at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under [Recruitment.](https://careers.booztgroup.com/pages/recruitment)[](https://careers.booztgroup.com/pages/recruitment)**Boozt perks**+5 vacation days.Health insurance and Office bikes.Scandinavian workplace culture. Focusing on work-life balance.International team. Multicultural colleagues, cross-functional teams, and daily English communication with a good sense of humor.Generous staff discount.

**Salary: 4500-5700 Eur gross**

**A LITTLE BIT ABOUT US**We are one of the leading e-commerce players in the Nordics. We offer our customers fashion, kids, sports, beauty, and home on [](https://boozt.com)[Boozt.com](https://boozt.com) and [](https://booztlet.com)[Booztlet.com](https://booztlet.com). Headquartered in Copenhagen, with over 1,100 colleagues across Europe, tech hubs in Vilnius and Poznań, and a fully automated warehouse in Ängelholm, we create value for both consumers and brands while fostering diversity, inclusion, and innovation.

Be a part of Boozt, a fast-growing Nordic tech company revolutionizing fashion and lifestyle e-commerce with cutting-edge innovations.

We're seeking an experienced iOS Developer. With minimum 3 years experience in iOS development and strong knowledge of HTTP, REST, and software patterns like SOLID, you'll tackle exciting challenges.

Boozt employs advanced tech solutions, using a unique system called the Solar System, strategic to core business functions and customer experiences.

Work involves exciting projects such as developing new apps for our robotified warehouse, Booztlet Stores, and end-customers, incorporating innovation.

Join an international team with a Nordic flat structure, fostering collaboration, diversity, and a healthy work-life balance across multiple offices.

Operate in a hybrid work environment with a base location in Vilnius. Engage with team members across various cities for a cross-cultural experience.

Enjoy a competitive gross salary range of 4500-5700 EUR with additional perks such as health insurance, office bikes, and generous staff discounts.

Interact with modularized codebases and participate in the iOS Chapter, influencing future tech directions and solving challenges in app development.

Boozt is all about empowering employees to make impactful contributions. Be part of a vibrant team where your work directly influences the company's success.

Join Boozt to expand your iOS development skills, be part of innovative projects, enjoy a vibrant, multicultural workplace, and contribute to leading e-commerce advancements.

Are you ready to embrace the future and be part of something transformative? We are seeking innovative and forward-thinking individuals who are eager to contribute to the development of cutting-edge technological solutions. Your efforts will directly impact our mission to revolutionize the industry.

**Webshop's branch** primary goal is to craft and enhance the best shopping experience for our users. Within this branch, our squads take on a range of challenges, including: Navigation, Search, Discounts, Product Pages, and much more.

The core of this team is a blame-free environment where we are curious, diverse and open-minded. Here we are driving our own projects and collaborating in the big picture making sure everything combines to a great development environment. We believe that we grow together and can be mentors to each other.

● Automation of manual tasks to help the business users do their everyday work.

● Update and improve new and existing technologies to ensure high system performance.

● Implementation of new features and functions.

● Multiple deployments a day due to continuous integration and an agile workflow.

● Interaction with various business units to help determine, plan and specify projects.

● Maintaining and improving system integrations (RabbitMQ and Google Pub/Sub and various APIs).

● At least 4 years of working experience in PHP Development.

● Experience working with PHP frameworks (Symfony is a plus).

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We're a Nordic e-commerce company that happens to be a tech company underneath. Two apps - Boozt and Booztlet - a lot of customers, and a QA chapter of four that's been building out our automation over the past year, who are looking for a member.

We work in squads that own backend, web, and mobile. Mobile is home turf for QAs, but we're comfortable going into a neighbour's code or picking up their testing too.

QA’s work is a mix: interesting new features, regression that nobody writes home about, and the automation we're building to shrink that part.**What you'll do**

* Test our apps by hand, automate what deserves automating, and keep shrinking the manual half.

* Be the quality voice inside your squad - not the gate at the end of the line. Devs, PM, design: you're in the room while decisions are made, not after.

* Be a proactive member of the QA Chapter - what we do, where we're going, and how we know it's working. Share your expertise along the way; the chapter gets better together.

* Live with AI in your daily work, agents, skills, MCP servers, and keep pushing it into more of what we do. It definitely helps produce more code; we should be sure it is high quality one.

* Keep your own skills sharp - new tools, new practices, whatever the field throws at us. We give you a full day every sprint for exactly that: Research Friday.

**You'll fit if**

* 4+ years in testing, preferably mobile applications.

* Hands-on experience writing code and maintaining automated tests - XCUITest or Espresso preferred; solid web or backend automation works too, as long as you can reason about what belongs at which level.

* Worked as part of an engineering team: briefings, code review, a shared repository, decisions made together rather than alone.

* A habit of staying current with AI - you understand what it's good for and what it isn't, and you use it (or want to use it) daily with a healthy dose of scepticism.

* Independence and follow-through - you finish what you start, because this is who you are.

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!**

Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (PHP)
jobs.description:
NFQ is a core technology partner for HomeToGo – a dedicated team of software engineers and data science professionals driving innovation to power a marketplace with the world’s largest selection of vacation rentals. We are expanding HomeToGo’s technology teams in Lithuania and Poland and are looking for the brightest talents to join the company.

HomeToGo is the SaaS-enabled marketplace with the world's largest selection of vacation rentals, listing millions of offers from thousands of trusted partners, including Booking.com, Vrbo and TripAdvisor. From vacation homes, cabins, beach houses, apartments, condos, house boats, castles, farm stays and everything in between, HomeToGo combines price, destination, dates and amenities to find the perfect accommodation for any trip worldwide.

Founded in 2014, HomeToGo operates localized apps and websites in more than 30 countries across Europe, North America, South America, Australia, and Asia-Pacific. HomeToGo Group includes brands such as Agriturismo.it, AMIVAC, Interhome, Smoobu, Casamundo, EscapadaRural, Kurzurlaub, Tripping.com, Wimdu, and others.

As a **Software Engineer (PHP)**, you will join the team behind HomeToGo's revenue platform, which sits at the centre of the company's financial operations, from the revenue earned across its brands to the money exchanged with its partners. The platform is deeply integrated with Salesforce, SAP and partner systems. Teams throughout the company depend on its output, which makes understanding the business processes a part of your job. You will work with rich domain logic, enterprise integrations and the engineering discipline that keeps a critical platform reliable, observable and easy to evolve. You will take ownership of features and see them through to production, in direct collaboration with business and technical stakeholders across the company. The team is experienced and values solid engineering, effective feedback and honest conversations about trade-offs.

# In this role, you will

* Implement and evolve the rules that determine what the company earns and what it owes its partners, based on requirements from business stakeholders

* Build and maintain the API- and event-based integrations that keep the platform consistent with Salesforce, SAP, payment systems and booking providers, in close collaboration with engineering teams across HomeToGo

* Extend the platform with LLM-based tooling, from MCP servers that expose its data safely to business teams and AI agents, to agent workflows that automate operational work

* Deliver trustworthy data to Finance and Business Intelligence, from the exports that feed the data warehouse to the alerting and quality checks around them

* Replace manual financial workflows with automated, tested processes, in collaboration with the teams who run them today

* Keep the platform reliable and observable, using Grafana, Prometheus and Kibana to monitor it in production, respond to incidents, find root causes and turn recurring problems into lasting fixes

* Work across a set of applications written in modern PHP on Symfony 7 and 8, backed by MySQL, Redis and RabbitMQ, deployed on Kubernetes alongside AWS managed services

* Take part in the platform's technical evolution, including completing its move to Kubernetes, regular framework and dependency upgrades as well as the retirement of legacy components

* Take ownership of your features from refinement to production, and take an active part in code review, planning and retrospectives

,

# What you will bring

* 2+ years of professional backend development, in PHP and Symfony or in another object-oriented language with the willingness to make PHP your main one

* Solid knowledge of relational databases: schema design, transactions, indexes and the ability to reason about a query plan

* Practical experience with LLM-based tools, both as a user in your daily engineering work and as a builder: MCP servers, agent frameworks such as Google ADK, or comparable projects of your own

* A habit of writing tests as part of your normal workflow, and a serious attitude to static analysis and code review

* Willingness to work directly with business stakeholders and to invest time in understanding their processes as thoroughly as the code that supports them

* The ability to explain technical decisions to people outside engineering, and to ask precise questions when a requirement is unclear

* Continuous learning as a habit, whether that means a new tool, a new part of the business or a better way of working the team has agreed on

* Working English, spoken and written. The team works daily with colleagues across Europe and beyond

**Nice to have:**

* Experience building and consuming APIs, and some exposure to asynchronous or message-based processing with RabbitMQ, Kinesis, SQS or similar

* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes and AWS managed services

* Familiarity with Grafana, Prometheus, Kibana or a comparable monitoring stack

,

# What we offer

* **Growth and development opportunities.** Build your career with support from an international and experienced team. We offer mentoring, regular feedback through our 360° feedback process, performance evaluations, and opportunities to grow professionally.

* **A culture where you can make an impact.** Join a workplace built on trust, empowerment, recognition, and autonomy. We share company goals transparently every quarter and encourage everyone to contribute ideas and take ownership.

* **A supportive and international environment.** Become part of a diverse team of 30+ nationalities, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and mutual support are part of everyday life. We value work-life balance and create an environment where people can thrive.

* **A great benefits package.** We offer a competitive salary, health insurance, additional days off, flexible working hours, employee-led workshops, office perks, regular team-building activities and company events.

**Salary range:** € 3000 - 5500 gross / month

If you have any questions, please contact me at monika.radzeviciute@nfq.com or via [Linkedin](https://linkedin.com/in/monikaradzeviciute).

**Check all our career opportunities** [**here**](https://nfq.com/career)**.**

Not the soul-crushing kind of boring — more like the “no drama, no chaos, just smart people doing great work” kind. The kind that lets you focus on what matters, without pointless meetings, micromanagement, or bureaucracy. We’re data-driven. We test, we iterate, we improve. Gut feelings don’t drive decisions — insights do. We trust each other. We’re transparent, give real feedback, and actually listen. No egos, no hand-holding — just a team of experienced professionals moving fast, adapting easily, and delivering impact. Omnisend is customer-funded and customer-driven. Our work is rooted in solving real problems that help ecommerce brands grow. No empty promises — we bring in results. And yes, we have fun. **ABOUT BURGA**

From a 7m² flat with just one printer in 2015 to a global powerhouse with 4+ million customers, 12+ million products sold, and revenue of over $147 million in 2025 - BURGA is not your average brand. Our products have been spotted with some of the world’s biggest celebrities, like Taylor Swift, Cara Delevingne, Lucy Hale, Alexis Ren, and many more.

We're on a mission to turn ordinary into extraordinary by transforming everyday items into style statement accessories. To keep up with our growth, we’re building a 10-million-euro manufacturing facility in Kaunas, set to produce 40,000 items daily. 

With unicorn ambitions and 500+ passionate humans on a mission to conquer the world, you’re joining a team that’s rewriting the rules.Oh, and we just landed a spot among Lithuania's TOP 10 most attractive employers in 2026, so the word is officially out.

Curious about our day-to-day life? Take a peek at Instagram [@burgainsider](https://instagram.com/burgainsider?hl=en)**ABOUT THE POSITION**

**Infrastructure Engineer** at BURGA is more than just a title - it’s a front-row seat to the evolution of a brand that’s taking the world by storm. You'll be at the heart of an extremely versatile and fast-paced environment, where new collections, campaigns, and product launches will keep you sharp and excited.

Your Role: build, operate, improve, and secure a reliable infrastructure platform that can keep up with BURGA’s growth. You’ll work closely with our IT, Data, and MES teams, taking ownership of complex infrastructure challenges and driving projects that will shape our technical environment in 2026 and beyond.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Own and operate our 3-node Proxmox virtualization cluster, including VM provisioning, patching, capacity planning, storage, and backups.

* Administer and evolve our production Kubernetes platform, running on Talos Linux with Cilium CNI/eBPF and supporting critical MES and Data Platform workloads.

* Own our GitOps delivery model using ArgoCD, Helm, Azure DevOps repositories, and Azure Container Registry.

* Maintain and evolve key platform components including cert-manager, Traefik, External Secrets Operator, HashiCorp Vault, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, and Valkey.

* Own our network and security infrastructure, including FortiGate firewalls, routing, VLANs, TLS termination, nginx, and Kubernetes ingress.

* Lead the monitoring and observability stack across Proxmox and Kubernetes using Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, and Alertmanager.

* Own backup and disaster-recovery processes using Proxmox Backup Server, Velero, and pgBackRest, including regular restore testing.

* Lead the migration of approximately 16 Docker Compose services from VMs to the production Kubernetes cluster.

* Manage the secrets lifecycle across Vault, External Secrets Operator, and Google Cloud Secret Manager.

* Act as the escalation point for infrastructure incidents, driving root-cause analysis, postmortems, and runbook documentation.

* Partner with the Data and MES teams on capacity planning, network architecture, and infrastructure requirements.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* Solid hands-on Linux administration experience in a production environment.

* Production experience administering and troubleshooting Kubernetes. Experience with Talos Linux or another immutable OS is a strong plus.

* Hands-on experience with Proxmox, VMware, or a similar virtualization platform, including VM lifecycle management and SAN/ZFS/iSCSI/NFS-backed storage.

* Experience with GitOps and CD tooling, such as ArgoCD, Flux, or similar, plus Helm chart management.

* Practical experience with enterprise networking and firewalls, including VLANs, routing, TLS termination, ingress, and reverse proxies.

* Experience operating a monitoring and observability stack, such as Prometheus and Grafana.

* Ability to automate and build tooling using Python or Bash.

* Familiarity with CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or similar.

* Comfortable taking ownership of on-call and production incident response.

* Strong troubleshooting skills and a proactive approach to improving reliability and security.

**SALARY:** 4600 - 5000 EUR/Month GROSS. We’re open to discussing it based on your skills and competencies.

**EXTRA SWEETENERS**

**Epic Team-Buildings:** Enjoy team-building activities, including our all-talked-about Christmas parties.

**Annual Workation:** Pack your laptop and join us for an epic workation that blends work and play, recharging your batteries and sparking creativity.

**Invest in Your Growth:** Every team member receives an annual 650 EUR learning & development budget to spend on courses, conferences, books, certifications, coaching, or team training. Your growth is our priority. 

**Birthday Treat:** Enjoy a free day off on your birthday.

**Exclusive Vouchers and Free BURGA Goodies:** Enjoy exclusive discounts and free BURGA products - perks of being part of our team.

**Health Insurance:** Take care of your health and well-being by using the perk of our private health insurance (after 6 months)

**Extra Days off:** The longer you’re with us, the more time you get to unwind - earn an extra day of vacation for every year with us.

**Pleasant Workplace Environment:** Work in a joyful space with occasional Friday team brunches, pet-friendly offices, and regular visits to our Kaunas and Vilnius locations.

**Flexible Working Arrangements:** Embrace a hybrid work model or take advantage of personal workations.

**ABOUT REIZ TECH**

Reiz Tech is more than just an IT company. We are a trusted end-to-end IT advisor throughout clients’ business lifecycle. We have a growing global presence in more than 30 countries and regions, united to deliver end-to-end IT solutions. Our talents work together remotely, and low leadership levels are decentralized for better communication, decision-making, and flexibility. 

**ABOUT THE ROLE** 

Join our Development team to support the growth of our fintech product. As a **Mid PHP Developer**, you will play a key role in designing, building, and scaling high-performance backend systems. You will take ownership of complex technical solutions, contribute to architectural decisions, and ensure the delivery of secure, robust, and maintainable code aligned with fintech industry standards.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems using PHP (8.x) and modern frameworks (Laravel or Symfony).

* Architect robust, secure, and high-performing solutions aligned with fintech standards.

* Build and maintain REST APIs, ensuring proper versioning and backward compatibility.

* Optimize database performance (MySQL/MariaDB), including query tuning, schema design, and migrations.

* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines and containerized environments (Docker).

* Ensure code quality through testing strategies (unit, integration, feature tests) and code reviews.

* Apply SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean architecture in everyday development.

* Monitor application performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimizations.

* Enforce security best practices (OWASP, secure authentication flows, data protection, GDPR compliance).

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

* Mentor junior and mid-level developers through code reviews and technical guidance.

* Contribute to technical decision-making, challenge requirements constructively, and promote best practices.

* Experience with PHPUnit and defining test strategies

* Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized production environments

* Strong knowledge of caching strategies and performance optimization

* Experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub preferred)

* Solid understanding of Composer and dependency management

* Comfortable working in Linux/CLI environments

* Strong understanding of security best practices in web applications

**SOFT SKILLS**

* Ability to independently design and architect solutions

* Strong problem-solving mindset with focus on maintainability and scalability

* Confidence to challenge requirements and propose better alternatives

* Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions

* Experience leading initiatives or small teams

* Strong written communication skills in async environments

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience in fintech or financial services domain

* Frontend development skills ([Vue.js](https://vue.js) or React)

* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred)

* Previous experience in technical interviewing or hiring

* Salary range: €5000 - €5800 (GROSS) / month.

* Fully remote work with flexible work hours and vacation policy. 

* A diverse international work environment that promotes inclusivity and collaboration. 

* Internal mentorship program. 

* Additional healthcare insurance, loyalty days.

* Internal events and Learning Sessions. 

* Team-building compensation every quarter. 

* Participation in local events in Lithuania such as wakeboarding, excursions, and Meet and Eat gatherings. 

* Ability to change the project you’re working on. 

* Referral bonuses.

**ABOUT REIZ TECH**

Reiz Tech is more than just an IT company. We are a trusted end-to-end IT advisor throughout clients’ business lifecycle. We have a growing global presence in more than 30 countries and regions, united to deliver end-to-end IT solutions. Our talents work together remotely, and low leadership levels are decentralized for better communication, decision-making, and flexibility. 

**ABOUT THE ROLE** 

Join our Development team to support the growth of our fintech product. As a **Senior PHP Developer**, you will play a key role in designing, building, and scaling high-performance backend systems. You will take ownership of complex technical solutions, contribute to architectural decisions, and ensure the delivery of secure, robust, and maintainable code aligned with fintech industry standards.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems using PHP (8.x) and modern frameworks (Laravel or Symfony).

* Architect robust, secure, and high-performing solutions aligned with fintech standards.

* Build and maintain REST APIs, ensuring proper versioning and backward compatibility.

* Optimize database performance (MySQL/MariaDB), including query tuning, schema design, and migrations.

* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines and containerized environments (Docker).

* Ensure code quality through testing strategies (unit, integration, feature tests) and code reviews.

* Apply SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean architecture in everyday development.

* Monitor application performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimizations.

* Enforce security best practices (OWASP, secure authentication flows, data protection, GDPR compliance).

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

* Mentor junior and mid-level developers through code reviews and technical guidance.

* Contribute to technical decision-making, challenge requirements constructively, and promote best practices.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* 5+ years of professional experience in software development

* Expert-level knowledge of PHP [8.x](https://8.x) and modern development practices

* 5+ years of experience with Laravel or Symfony, including deep framework understanding

* Strong experience with MySQL or MariaDB (query optimization, schema design, normalization)

* Solid understanding of REST API design principles

* Proficiency with Git (branching strategies, code reviews, release workflows)

* Experience with PHPUnit and defining test strategies

* Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized production environments

* Strong knowledge of caching strategies and performance optimization

* Experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub preferred)

* Solid understanding of Composer and dependency management

* Comfortable working in Linux/CLI environments

* Strong understanding of security best practices in web applications

**SOFT SKILLS**

* Ability to independently design and architect solutions

* Strong problem-solving mindset with focus on maintainability and scalability

* Confidence to challenge requirements and propose better alternatives

* Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions

* Experience leading initiatives or small teams

* Strong written communication skills in async environments

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience in fintech or financial services domain

* Frontend development skills ([Vue.js](https://vue.js) or React)

* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred)

* Previous experience in technical interviewing or hiring

* Salary range: €5500 - €7000 (GROSS) / month.

* Fully remote work with flexible work hours and vacation policy. 

* A diverse international work environment that promotes inclusivity and collaboration. 

* Internal mentorship program. 

* Additional healthcare insurance, loyalty days. 

* Compensated professional development opportunities, including learning materials and certification exam fees. 

* Internal events and Learning Sessions. 

* Team-building compensation every quarter. 

* Participation in local events in Lithuania such as wakeboarding, excursions, and Meet and Eat gatherings. 

* Ability to change the project you’re working on. 

* Referral bonuses.

jobs.title: Senior Front-end Engineer
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Ovoko is transforming Europe’s €30B+ used car parts market - a massive, fragmented industry still largely offline. We connect 7,000+ scrapyard owners, car parts sellers and dismantlers with millions of buyers through our marketplace, SaaS and logistics platform, making it effortless to trade parts across borders. With over 42 million parts listed, we’ve grown into one of Europe’s fastest-scaling e-commerce companies, but the real opportunity lies ahead, as we build a real category-defining platform worldwide.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As a Front-end Engineer at Ovoko, you will work closely with other members of the product team to create visually appealing and user-friendly interfaces, and collaborate with back-end developers to ensure that the web applications function smoothly. This is a role that will allow you to use your technical skills and creativity to make a real impact on the success of our company's online presence.

# IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

* Continuously collaborate with back-end developers and UX/UI designers to improve usability of our applications

* Promote high-impact tech initiatives and work on improving our web applications based on business needs

* Define best-in-class front-end engineering standards and practices, by staying on top of emerging technologies.

,

* Broad hands-on experience creating front-end projects using TypeScript and React frameworks

* In-depth understanding of the entire web development process (from design to development and deployment)

* Experience working with micro frontends (e.g. Module federation) would be great

* Experience with browser testing and debugging

* Experience writing tests using Jest/Vitest/React Testing Library

* Refine leadership skills by leading and owning features from inception to production

* Fluent in spoken and written English.

The offered salary range for this position starts at 5000 € (gross) per month. Please keep in mind that we are also open to discuss your salary expectations based on your competencies and experience.

• Private health insurance

jobs.title: Platform Engineer - AI Operations
jobs.description:
[Signicat](https://signicat.com) is a pan-European digital identity company that makes it easy and safe for organisations to know who they are interacting with online. Using our proprietary technology, we help companies and public organisations securely verify the identities of people and businesses, authenticate users, and enable compliant electronic document signing, so their customers can access services and complete online processes with confidence.Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale. Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world.

Please note that due to the summer holiday season, interviews for this position will resume after August 10th.

About the RoleAs a Platform Engineer focused on AI Operations, you will work on the design and development of Signicat's internal AI Background Agents Platform, empowering our product developers to easily build, test, and deploy their own autonomous agents to accelerate our digital identity capabilities.

We’re looking for an innovative and passionate engineer to join our DevTools team within the Platform Tribe. You’ll help design, build, and manage the software systems, sandboxes, and environments that make these agents secure, observable, and easy to deploy. While the AI Agents Platform is a major focus, you will also actively participate in the day-to-day operations of the DevTools team, contributing to general developer experience (DevEx) initiatives, shared engineering infrastructure, and developer-facing tooling.

How You'll Make An Impact

* You’ll think deeply about systems — their edge cases, failure modes, and lifecycles to architect and construct the self-service APIs, services, and CLI tools that form our internal AI Background Agents Platform.

* You’ll build secure, stateful runtime harnesses that host autonomous agents, handling their lifecycles, execution sandboxing, and tool or API invocations.

* You’ll design robust CI/CD pipelines and automated GitOps engines to support progressive delivery (canary, blue-green) of both the platform itself and the agents running on it.

* You’ll implement core platform security guardrails to defend against execution-level vulnerabilities and prompt injections.

* You’ll build centralized distributed tracing and monitoring to give developers complete visibility into multi-step agent decisions, LLM calls, and iteration loops.

* You’ll actively contribute to the DevTools team's day-to-day work—maintaining shared developer infrastructure, building general-purpose CLI utilities, and resolving developer experience bottlenecks across the engineering organization.

* You'll offer mentorship and guidance on the best ways to design and implement platform-level solutions across all our products.

Why We'll Love You

* You design, build, and deploy scalable services and platform APIs.

* You have strong production experience using Python and Go to build back-end services or developer-facing tooling.

* You have a proven track record of designing clean API contracts and building systems where other software developers are your primary consumers.

* You are well-versed in Kubernetes-based environments and deploying containerized workloads.

* You have experience with GitOps, continuous delivery patterns, and implementing progressive deployment strategies.

* You have a conceptual or hands-on understanding of how LLM-backed systems operate, including memory management, tool calling, and frameworks (such as Google ADK, LangChain, or similar).

* You write testable, clean code, design backward-compatible interfaces, and produce high-quality technical documentation.

* You have experience with, or a strong interest in, creating reproducible, localized developer workflows using tools like Nix or devenv.

* You understand sandboxing techniques (e.g., gVisor, WebAssembly, or isolated Docker runtimes).

* You have experience with enterprise observability stacks (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Datadog) to manage and debug distributed services.

This is a wish list, if you have half of it we are already interested!

**What we offer:**

* **Tailored benefits package by location** - we aim to empower our employees by offering customised benefits suited to each market

* **Your tech, your way** - choose the tech gear that aligns with your comfort and meets your preferences

* **Remote work style -** while you embrace a remote environment, we support occasional in-person gatherings to strengthen the teamwork

* **Work-life balance** - enjoy an extra 5 paid days off annually, and we make sure to celebrate your work anniversaries to acknowledge the milestones you achieve

* **Health & Wellness** - we prioritise your physical and mental well-being by providing designated packs and access to the Headspace app

* **Continuous growth** - quarterly development talks, a dedicated time during working hours each week for training and development, access to Udemy courses, defined career paths, and internal mentorship opportunities

* **Customised onboarding** - we will prepare an Onboarding Plan to ensure an easy and smooth beginning

* **Be part of an international team** - the opportunity to work from any other Signicat office for 2 months per year and 3 weeks per year from any EU country

* **Empowering feedback culture** - by using employee engagement tools, we ensure that every voice is heard, empowering us to grow together

* **Meet-ups** - frequent office gatherings and biennial Kick-off event to bring every Signicat under one roof that you don’t want to miss

**Salary:**€70,000-€90,000 gross yearly. We are open to discussing the salary based on your skills and competencies.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
**500M+ downloads. 80M+ monthly users. A decade of building – and we’re still accelerating.**

Flo is the world’s #1 health & fitness app worldwide on a mission to build a better future for female health. Backed by a $200M investment led by General Atlantic, we became the first product of our kind to reach a $1B valuation in 2024 – and we’re not slowing down.

With 7M paid subscribers and the highest-rated experience in the App Store’s health category, we’ve spent 10 years earning trust at scale. Now, we’re building the next generation of digital health – AI-powered, privacy-first, clinically backed – to help our users know their body better.

**The job**

We’re looking for a **Senior Frontend Engineer** to help us build the next generation of Flo’s platform and user experiences. 

You’ll work on the foundation that powers interactive surveys and dynamic content inside the Flo app — building SDKs, reusable components, and internal tooling that enable other product teams to deliver exceptional experiences quickly and reliably.

Our frontend stack is based on **React**, **TypeScript**, and **Next.js**, with a strong focus on performance, maintainability, and testing. 

We care deeply about quality: we use TypeScript for type safety, Jest and Playwright for automated testing, and continuously evolve our design system and UI Kit.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Design, build, and maintain high-quality user-facing components and platform SDKs that enable survey and interactive experiences in the Flo ecosystem.

* Collaborate with product, design, and backend engineers to deliver flexible and scalable solutions.

* Contribute to Flo’s design system and shared UI libraries, ensuring consistency and reusability across products.

* Refactor and improve existing codebases for performance, reliability, and maintainability.

* Write clean, modular, well-documented code and advocate for engineering best practices.

* Actively participate in the frontend community at Flo, sharing ideas and driving improvements in architecture and development processes.

**Your Experience**

**Must have:**

* 7+ years of experience building, shipping, and maintaining modern web applications.

* Expert-level knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (ES6+).

NFQ is a core technology partner for HomeToGo – a dedicated team of software engineers and data science professionals driving innovation to power a marketplace with the world’s largest selection of vacation rentals. We are expanding HomeToGo’s technology team in Lithuania and are looking for the brightest talents to join this growing company.

HomeToGo is the marketplace with the world's largest selection of vacation rentals, listing millions of offers from thousands of trusted partners, including Booking.com, Vrbo and TripAdvisor. From vacation homes, cabins, beach houses, apartments, condos, house boats, castles, farm stays and everything in between, HomeToGo combines price, destination, dates and amenities to find the perfect accommodation for any trip worldwide.

Founded in 2014, HomeToGo operates localized apps & websites in 25 countries across Europe, North America, South America, Australia and Asia-Pacific. HomeToGo also operates brands such as Agriturismo.it, AMIVAC, Casamundo, CaseVacanza.it, e-domizil, EscapadaRural, Tripping.com and Wimdu.

Our diverse and modern tech stack includes Symfony, MariaDB, ElasticSearch, Snowflake, Redis, Aerospike, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, and more. With millions of properties listed on our product, this is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact. Apply now and lead our team to new heights!

* Partner with Product to impact the roadmap and ensure engineering decisions align with user needs

* Take ownership of engineering decisions for larger topics and features

* Be a part of a push to improve the product delivery process

* Understanding the fundamental design principles behind a scalable application

* Fluency in both Lithuanian and English

,

Vai esi gatavs pacelt savu ietekmi e-komercijas nozarē? Uzņēmumā **Kesko Senukai Digital** meklējam **mid-level PHP programmētāju**, kas pievienotos mūsu augošajai komandai. Tu strādāsi pie jauna liela mēroga projekta, kas katru dienu ietekmē tūkstošiem lietotāju visā Baltijā.

**Kāpēc pievienoties mums?**

* **Ietekme:** Strādā ar lielas slodzes sistēmām un nozīmīgiem digitāliem risinājumiem.

* **Kompetence:** Sadarbojies ar pieredzējušiem speciālistiem dinamiskā vidē.

* **Līdzsvars:** Baudi hibrīda darba modeli un izaugsmes iespējas.

**Ko Tu darīsi:**

* **Veidot un ieviest jauninājumus:** Programmēt augstas veiktspējas lietojumprogrammas, izmantojot PHP un Symfony, ieviešot jaunu funkcionalitāti atbilstoši biznesa vajadzībām.

* **Optimizēt un nodrošināt drošību:** Projektēt PostgreSQL shēmas, nodrošināt stabilitāti ar automatizētu testēšanu un uzturēt augstākā līmeņa drošības praksi.

* **Sadarboties un piegādāt:** Strādāt kopā ar arhitektiem, produktu īpašniekiem un DevOps komandu, lai saskaņotu risinājumus ar stratēģiju un novērstu ražošanas incidentus.

**Ko mēs sagaidām:**

* 2+ gadu PHP programmēšanas pieredze (vēlama Symfony).

* Labas PostgreSQL un vaicājumu optimizācijas prasmes.

* Pieredze ar REST API, Git un Docker.

* Proaktīva domāšana un labas angļu valodas prasmes.

**Ko mēs piedāvājam:**
